methods_quotes.q: Data were weighted by the inverse probability of selection and summed to produce national estimates.
Confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated by using a direct variance estimation procedure that accounted for the sample weights and complex sample design.
Denominators for rates were calculated by summing the proportional fraction of the population for each year
